claims.verdict: The four-variable Boolean witness exactly refutes a depth-independent memoryless positive-variation payment by total influence or distinct-union influence paid once.

claims.statement: A replayable two-way edge with unequal potential values has unbounded positive variation over arbitrary alternating walks, although its signed variation telescopes. Therefore a fixed-resource positive-variation bound over all walks requires constancy on replayable communicating components or a bound on revisits.
